vsm2.20:105.1: Athassa imāya taruṇavipassanāya āraddhavipassakassa dasa vipassanupakkilesā uppajjanti.
vsm2.20:105.2: Vipassanupakkilesā hi paṭivedhappattassa ariyasāvakassa ceva vippaṭipannakassa ca nikkhittakammaṭṭhānassa kusītapuggalassa nuppajjanti.
vsm2.20:105.3: Sammāpaṭipannakassa pana yuttapayuttassa āraddhavipassakassa kulaputtassa uppajjantiyeva.
vsm2.20:105.5: Obhāso, ñāṇaṃ, pīti, passaddhi, sukhaṃ, adhimokkho, paggaho, upaṭṭhānaṃ, upekkhā, nikantīti.
vsm2.20:106.2: Aniccato manasikaroto obhāso uppajjati, ‘obhāso dhammo’ti obhāsaṃ āvajjati, tato vikkhepo uddhaccaṃ.
vsm2.20:106.3: Tena uddhaccena viggahitamānaso aniccato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. Dukkhato… anattato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti’’.
vsm2.20:106.4: Tathā ‘‘aniccato manasikaroto ñāṇaṃ uppajjati…pe… pīti… passaddhi… sukhaṃ… adhimokkho… paggaho… upaṭṭhānaṃ… upekkhā… nikanti uppajjati, ‘nikanti dhammo’ti nikantiṃ āvajjati, tato vikkhepo uddhaccaṃ.
vsm2.20:106.5: Tena uddhaccena viggahitamānaso aniccato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. Dukkhato… anattato upaṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānātī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 2.6).
vsm2.20:107.2: Tasmiṃ uppanne yogāvacaro ‘‘na vata me ito pubbe evarūpo obhāso uppannapubbo, addhā maggappattosmi phalapattosmī’’ti amaggameva ‘‘maggo’’ti, aphalameva ca ‘‘phala’’nti gaṇhāti.
vsm2.20:107.3: Tassa amaggaṃ ‘‘maggo’’ti aphalaṃ ‘‘phala’’nti gaṇhato vipassanāvīthi ukkantā nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:107.4: So attano mūlakammaṭṭhānaṃ vissajjetvā obhāsameva assādento nisīdati.
vsm2.20:108.1: So kho panāyaṃ obhāso kassaci bhikkhuno pallaṅkaṭṭhānamattameva obhāsento uppajjati. Kassaci antogabbhaṃ. Kassaci bahigabbhampi.
vsm2.20:108.2: Kassaci sakalavihāraṃ, gāvutaṃ, aḍḍhayojanaṃ, yojanaṃ, dviyojanaṃ, tiyojanaṃ…pe… kassaci pathavītalato yāva akaniṭṭhabrahmalokā ekālokaṃ kurumāno.
vsm2.20:109.1: Evaṃ vemattatāya cassa idaṃ vatthu – cittalapabbate kira dvikuṭṭagehassa anto dve therā nisīdiṃsu.
vsm2.20:109.2: Taṃdivasañca kāḷapakkhuposatho hoti, meghapaṭalacchannā disā, rattibhāge caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ tamaṃ pavattati.
vsm2.20:109.3: Atheko thero āha – ‘‘bhante, mayhaṃ idāni cetiyaṅgaṇamhi sīhāsane pañcavaṇṇāni kusumāni paññāyantī’’ti.
vsm2.20:109.4: Taṃ itaro āha – ‘‘anacchariyaṃ, āvuso, kathesi, mayhaṃ panetarahi mahāsamuddamhi yojanaṭṭhāne macchakacchapā paññāyantī’’ti.
vsm2.20:110.1: Ayaṃ pana vipassanupakkileso yebhuyyena samathavipassanālābhino uppajjati.
vsm2.20:110.2: So samāpattivikkhambhitānaṃ kilesānaṃ asamudācārato ‘‘arahā aha’’nti cittaṃ uppādeti uccavālikavāsī mahānāgatthero viya haṃkanakavāsī mahādattatthero viya cittalapabbate niṅkapeṇṇakapadhānagharavāsī cūḷasumanatthero viya ca.
vsm2.20:111.1: Tatridaṃ ekavatthuparidīpanaṃ – talaṅgaravāsī dhammadinnatthero kira nāma eko pabhinnapaṭisambhido mahākhīṇāsavo mahato bhikkhusaṅghassa ovādadāyako ahosi.
vsm2.20:111.2: So ekadivasaṃ attano divāṭṭhāne nisīditvā ‘‘kinnu kho amhākaṃ ācariyassa uccavālikavāsīmahānāgattherassa samaṇabhāvakiccaṃ matthakaṃ pattaṃ, no’’ti āvajjanto
vsm2.20:111.3: puthujjanabhāvamevassa disvā ‘‘mayi agacchante puthujjanakālakiriyameva karissatī’’ti ca ñatvā
vsm2.20:111.4: iddhiyā vehāsaṃ uppatitvā divāṭṭhāne nisinnassa therassa samīpe orohitvā vanditvā vattaṃ dassetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
vsm2.20:111.5: ‘‘Kiṃ, āvuso dhammadinna, akāle āgatosī’’ti ca vutte ‘‘pañhaṃ, bhante, pucchituṃ āgatomhī’’ti āha.
vsm2.20:111.6: Tato ‘‘pucchāvuso, jānamānā kathayissāmā’’ti vutte pañhasahassaṃ pucchi.
vsm2.20:112.2: Tato ‘‘atitikkhaṃ vo, bhante, ñāṇaṃ, kadā tumhehi ayaṃ dhammo adhigato’’ti vutte ‘‘ito saṭṭhivassakāle, āvuso’’ti āha.
vsm2.20:112.3: Samādhimpi, bhante, vaḷañjethāti, na yidaṃ, āvuso, bhāriyanti. Tena hi, bhante, ekaṃ hatthiṃ māpethāti.
vsm2.20:112.5: Idāni, bhante, yathā ayaṃ hatthī añcitakaṇṇo pasāritanaṅguṭṭho soṇḍaṃ mukhe pakkhipitvā bheravaṃ koñcanādaṃ karonto tumhākaṃ abhimukho āgacchati, tathā naṃ karothāti.
vsm2.20:112.6: Thero tathā katvā vegena āgacchato hatthissa bheravaṃ ākāraṃ disvā uṭṭhāya palāyituṃ āraddho.
vsm2.20:112.7: Tamenaṃ khīṇāsavatthero hatthaṃ pasāretvā cīvarakaṇṇe gahetvā ‘‘bhante, khīṇāsavassa sārajjaṃ nāma hotī’’ti āha.
vsm2.20:113.1: So tamhi kāle attano puthujjanabhāvaṃ ñatvā ‘‘avassayo me, āvuso, dhammadinna hohī’’ti vatvā pādamūle ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdi.
vsm2.20:113.2: ‘‘Bhante, tumhākaṃ avassayo bhavissāmiccevāhaṃ āgato, mā cintayitthā’’ti kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathesi.
vsm2.20:113.3: Thero kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā caṅkamaṃ āruyha tatiye padavāre aggaphalaṃ arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
vsm2.20:113.4: Thero kira dosacarito ahosi. Evarūpā bhikkhū obhāse kampanti.
vsm2.20:114.2: Tassa kira rūpārūpadhamme tulayantassa tīrentassa vissaṭṭhaindavajiramiva avihatavegaṃ tikhiṇaṃ sūraṃ ativisadaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
vsm2.20:115.2: Tassa kira tasmiṃ samaye khuddakāpīti, khaṇikāpīti, okkantikāpīti, ubbegāpīti, pharaṇāpītīti ayaṃ pañcavidhā pīti sakalasarīraṃ pūrayamānā uppajjati.
vsm2.20:116.2: Tassa kira tasmiṃ samaye rattiṭṭhāne vā divāṭṭhāne vā nisinnassa kāyacittānaṃ neva daratho, na gāravaṃ, na kakkhaḷatā, na akammaññatā, na gelaññaṃ, na vaṅkatā hoti,
vsm2.20:116.3: atha kho panassa kāyacittāni passaddhāni lahūni mudūni kammaññāni suvisadāni ujukāniyeva honti.
vsm2.20:116.4: So imehi passaddhādīhi anuggahitakāyacitto tasmiṃ samaye amānusiṃ nāma ratiṃ anubhavati. Yaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ –
vsm2.20:116.6: Evamassa imaṃ amānusiṃ ratiṃ sādhayamānā lahutādisampayuttā passaddhi uppajjati.
vsm2.20:117.2: Tassa kira tasmiṃ samaye sakalasarīraṃ abhisandayamānaṃ atipaṇītaṃ sukhaṃ uppajjati.
vsm2.20:118.2: Vipassanāsampayuttāyeva hissa cittacetasikānaṃ atisayapasādabhūtā balavatī saddhā uppajjati.
vsm2.20:119.2: Vipassanāsampayuttameva hissa asithilaṃ anaccāraddhaṃ supaggahitaṃ vīriyaṃ uppajjati.
vsm2.20:120.2: Vipassanāsampayuttāyeva hissa supaṭṭhitā supatiṭṭhitā nikhātā acalā pabbatarājasadisā sati uppajjati.
vsm2.20:120.3: So yaṃ yaṃ ṭhānaṃ āvajjati samannāharati manasikaroti paccavekkhati, taṃ taṃ ṭhānamassa okkhanditvā pakkhanditvā dibbacakkhuno paraloko viya satiyā upaṭṭhāti.
vsm2.20:121.2: Tasmiṃ hissa samaye sabbasaṅkhāresu majjhattabhūtā vipassanupekkhāpi balavatī uppajjati. Manodvāre āvajjanupekkhāpi.
vsm2.20:121.3: Sā hissa taṃ taṃ ṭhānaṃ āvajjantassa vissaṭṭhaindavajiramiva pattapuṭe pakkhitta tattanārāco viya ca sūrā tikhiṇā hutvā vahati.
vsm2.20:122.2: Evaṃ obhāsādipaṭimaṇḍitāya hissa vipassanāya ālayaṃ kurumānā sukhumā santākārā nikanti uppajjati.
vsm2.20:122.3: Yā nikanti kilesoti pariggahetumpi na sakkā hoti.
vsm2.20:123.1: Yathā ca obhāse, evaṃ etesupi aññatarasmiṃ uppanne yogāvacaro ‘‘na vata me ito pubbe evarūpaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppannapubbaṃ, evarūpā pīti, passaddhi, sukhaṃ, adhimokkho, paggaho, upaṭṭhānaṃ, upekkhā, nikanti uppannapubbā, addhā maggappattosmi phalappattosmī’’ti amaggameva ‘‘maggo’’ti aphalameva ca ‘‘phala’’nti gaṇhāti.
vsm2.20:123.2: Tassa amaggaṃ ‘‘maggo’’ti aphalaṃ ‘‘phala’’nti gaṇhato vipassanāvīthi ukkantā nāma hoti.
vsm2.20:123.3: So attano mūlakammaṭṭhānaṃ vissajjetvā nikantimeva assādento nisīdatīti.
vsm2.20:124.1: Ettha ca obhāsādayo upakkilesavatthutāya upakkilesāti vuttā, na akusalattā.
vsm2.20:124.2: Nikanti pana upakkileso ceva upakkilesavatthu ca.
vsm2.20:124.3: Vatthuvaseneva cete dasa. Gāhavasena pana samatiṃsa honti.
vsm2.20:125.2: ‘‘Mama obhāso uppanno’’ti gaṇhato hi diṭṭhigāho hoti,
vsm2.20:125.6: Tathā sesesupīti evaṃ gāhavasena samatiṃsa upakkilesā honti.
vsm2.20:125.7: Tesaṃ vasena akusalo abyatto yogāvacaro obhāsādīsu kampati vikkhipati.
vsm2.20:125.8: Obhāsādīsu ekekaṃ ‘‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’’ti (ma. ni. 1.241) samanupassati.
vsm2.20:126.1: Kusalo pana paṇḍito byatto buddhisampanno yogāvacaro obhāsādīsu uppannesu ‘‘ayaṃ kho me obhāso uppanno, so kho panāyaṃ anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno khayadhammo vayadhammo virāgadhammo nirodhadhammo’’ti iti vā taṃ paññāya paricchindati upaparikkhati.
vsm2.20:126.2: Atha vā panassa evaṃ hoti, ‘‘sace obhāso attā bhaveyya, ‘attā’ti gahetuṃ vaṭṭeyya.
vsm2.20:126.4: Tasmā so avasavattanaṭṭhena anattā, hutvā abhāvaṭṭhena anicco, uppādavayapaṭipīḷanaṭṭhena dukkho’’ti sabbaṃ arūpasattake vuttanayena vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm2.20:127.1: So evaṃ upaparikkhitvā obhāsaṃ ‘‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’’ti (ma. ni. 1.241) samanupassati.
vsm2.20:127.2: Ñāṇaṃ…pe… nikantiṃ ‘‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’’ti (ma. ni. 1.241) samanupassati.
vsm2.20:127.3: Evaṃ samanupassanto obhāsādīsu na kampati na vedhati. Tenāhu porāṇā –
vsm2.20:127.4:
‘‘Imāni dasa ṭhānāni, paññāyassa pariccitā;
Dhammuddhaccakusalo hoti, na ca vikkhepaṃ gacchatī’’ti. (paṭi. ma. 2.7);
vsm2.20:128.1: So evaṃ vikkhepaṃ agacchanto taṃ samatiṃsavidhaṃ upakkilesajaṭaṃ vijaṭetvā obhāsādayo dhammā na maggo.
vsm2.20:128.2: Upakkilesavimuttaṃ pana vīthipaṭipannaṃ vipassanāñāṇaṃ maggoti maggañca amaggañca vavatthapeti.
vsm2.20:129.1: Tassevaṃ ‘‘ayaṃ maggo, ayaṃ na maggo’’ti maggañca amaggañca ñatvā ṭhitaṃ ñāṇaṃ maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhīti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.20:130.1: Ettāvatā ca pana tena tiṇṇaṃ saccānaṃ vavatthānaṃ kataṃ hoti. Kathaṃ?
vsm2.20:130.2: Diṭṭhivisuddhiyaṃ tāva nāmarūpassa vavatthāpanena dukkhasaccassa vavatthānaṃ kataṃ.
vsm2.20:130.4: Imissaṃ maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhiyaṃ sammāmaggassa avadhāraṇena maggasaccassa vavatthānaṃ katanti,
vsm2.20:130.5: evaṃ lokiyeneva tāva ñāṇena tiṇṇaṃ saccānaṃ vavatthānaṃ kataṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:130.6:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Paññābhāvanādhikāre
Maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhiniddeso nāma
Vīsatimo paricchedo.
